using JSON3, Base64
d = mktempdir()
write(joinpath(d, "mpnn_fwbench.py"), base64decode(""))

res["data"] = isfile(joinpath(d, "out.json")) ? JSON3.read(read(joinpath(d, "out.json"), String), Dict{String,Any}) : nothing
println(JSON3.write(res))
